sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms govern the use of Midnight BiS Tracker (the 'Service').

sections.heading: 2. Service Description
sections.body: The Service provides a free tool for tracking Best in Slot items in World of Warcraft. The Service is not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft and related trademarks belong to Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

sections.heading: 3. Data Storage
sections.body: All user data is stored in your browser's localStorage and is never transmitted to external servers. Clearing your browser data may result in loss of saved information.

sections.heading: 4. Disclaimer
sections.body: The Service is provided 'as is' without warranty of accuracy or completeness. BiS data is based on external sources such as Maxroll.gg and may change with game patches. We are not liable for any damages resulting from use of the Service.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
sections.body: The Service uses the Wowhead tooltip API and scripts. Use of these external services is subject to their respective terms of service and privacy policies.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.body: The Service's source code is available on GitHub. World of Warcraft content copyrights belong to Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to Terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated without prior notice. Changes take effect upon posting to the Service.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: The Service does not require registration and does not collect or store personal information on any server. Character and gear data entered by users is stored only in the browser's localStorage.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies & Local Storage
sections.body: The Service uses browser localStorage to provide its functionality. This data exists only on your device and is never transmitted externally.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Services
sections.body:
The Service uses the following external services, each subject to their own privacy policies:
• Wowhead (wow.zamimg.com) — Item tooltips and stat lookups
• Google Fonts — Web font delivery
• Cloudflare Pages — Website hosting

These external services may collect basic connection information such as IP addresses.

sections.heading: 4. Data Deletion
sections.body: You can delete all stored data at any time through your browser's site data settings. You can also delete individual character data using the 'Reset' feature within the Service.

sections.heading: 5. Children's Privacy
sections.body: The Service does not intentionally collect personal information from children under the age of 14.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This privacy policy may be updated without prior notice. Changes take effect upon posting to the Service.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related inquiries, please reach out through our Discord channel.

charBar.title: Character Bar
charBar.desc:
Switch between registered characters here.
Each spec is tracked separately, even for the same character.
Click an icon to switch.

simc.title: Gear Import
simc.desc:
Paste the text from the /simc command in-game to auto-detect your equipped gear.
Sample data is already loaded for this demo.

tier.title: What You Run
tier.desc:
Say which keys you push and which raid difficulty you clear.
The grade each of them hands over is what every slot is measured against — a dungeon item against your key band, a raid item against your difficulty.

progress.title: Completion Rate
progress.desc:
Shows how many of your 16 slots meet the target.
Solid bar = BiS done, green bar = M+ BiS equipped, faint bar = Alt equipped.
Acquiring BiS grows the solid portion.

dungeon.title: Source Filter
dungeon.desc:
Click a dungeon/raid/crafted source to show only its items.
Bright number = BiS remaining, dim number = Alt remaining.
Higher priority sources are sorted first.

tier1.title: ▲ Stat Mismatch (Top Priority)
tier1.desc:
Your equipped item has completely different secondary stats from BiS.
Biggest performance loss — replace this first.

tier2.title: ◆ Alt Equipped
tier2.desc:
You have an alt with matching stats equipped.
Swap to BiS when available.

tier3.title: ↑ Enhance / Next Tier Needed
tier3.desc:
You have the BiS item but below target item level.
'Enhance needed' = upgradeable within current tier. 'Next tier needed' = re-acquire from higher content.

tier4.title: ✓ Farming Done
tier4.desc:
BiS equipped at or above target item level.
No more farming needed for this slot!

catDungeon.title: Source Filters
catDungeon.desc:
Click a dungeon/raid/crafted button to show only items from that source.
Numbers show BiS count + Alt count.

catCard.title: Item Card
catCard.desc:
Shows slot, source, and secondary stats.
Click the item name to view details on Wowhead.
Alt items share the same stat combo as BiS.

catSimc.title: Want to compare gear?
catSimc.desc:
Type /simc in-game, paste the output here,
and your equipped gear will be compared to BiS with auto-sorted farming priorities.
